about_the_game:
🐾 Lead the Flock, Protect Your Own!

Step into the paws of a brave bunny leader in this action-packed adventure!
In RrrrrAbbits, you command a flock of adorable—but vulnerable—rabbits as you explore, fight, build, and grow stronger together.

🛡️ Protect the Flock—Lose Them and It’s Game Over!

Your bunnies are your lifeline.
Enemies like crows are constantly trying to capture them—and they can’t fight back on their own.
Issue commands, keep them moving, and fight off attackers as their fearless leader!

🕵️‍♂️ Explore the World & Discover Rare Rabbits!

Hidden throughout the land are special rare bunnies that bring powerful abilities to your team:

  • 🥕 Explorer Bunny: Finds items and boosts resource gathering

  • 🛡️ Warrior Bunny: Automatically protects the flock

  • 🛠️ Builder Bunny: Unlocks advanced constructions in your home burrow

Find them, befriend them, and build the ultimate bunny squad!

⚔️ Strategic Combat with Style-Switching Action!

Choose your combat style to match the situation:

  • 💥 Combo Style: Unleash fast, satisfying attacks to knock enemies away

  • 🎈 Balloon Style: Float above the battlefield and issue orders from above

Adapt, protect, and outsmart your foes!

🏡 Build a Burrow Worthy of a Leader!

Gather materials through exploration and upgrade your bunny village.
New buildings and facilities increase your team size, boost leader stats,
and may even attract more rare rabbits to your side!

🕳️ Dive Into Dungeons to Rescue Captive Allies!

Progress through quests to unlock mysterious dungeons filled with traps and puzzles.
Defeat the crow bosses and free imprisoned rabbits to expand your team even further!

🎉 Become the Legendary Bunny Leader!

Explore. Battle. Build. Lead.
Can you protect your entire flock and defeat the final foe?
The future of the rabbits depends on you!

name: RrrrrAbbits
short_description: The rabbits are your companions, and their lives depend on you! Explore maps, gather resources, and expand your burrow. Recruit rare rabbits, protect your flock, and face the crows’ threats. Lead your rabbits to safety in this mix of exploration and strategy!
